factValues.value:
Statement of compliance
                            These financial statements have been prepared in compliance with FRS 105 – The Financial Reporting Standard applicable in the UK and Republic of Ireland and the Companies Act 2006.
                            
                              Basis of preparation
                            
                            The financial statements have been prepared  under the historical cost convention.
                            The financial statements are prepared in sterling which is the functional currency of the company.

factValues.name: gr:fact-c91872ebcec24a3f_fv
factValues.value: For the year ended 31 December 2024 the company was entitled to exemption from audit under section 477 of the Companies Act 2006 relating to small companies.

factValues.name: gr:fact-f4ff402e39decc4a_fv
factValues.value: The members have not required the company to obtain an audit of its accounts for the year in question in accordance with section 476.

factValues.name: gr:fact-fd37fe7a7ef29786_fv
factValues.value: The director acknowledges their responsibilities for complying with the requirements of the Companies Act 2006 with respect to accounting records and the preparation of accounts.

factValues.name: gr:fact-9baa7488f7982ad4_fv
factValues.value: These accounts have been prepared in accordance with the micro-entity provisions and FRS 105, the Financial Reporting Standard applicable to the micro-entities regime. The accounts have been delivered in accordance with the provisions applicable to companies subject to the small companies regime. The income statement has not been delivered to the Registrar of Companies.

factValues.name: gr:fact-386d444e56b137d2_fv
factValues.value: The members have agreed to the preparation of abridged accounts.
